say:1:1460462001:1.text: I... I think I've finally snapped out of it...

say:2:1460462002:1.text: You're back! Are you feeling okay? You were saying something about our little brother just now...
say:2:1460462002:1.source_cn: 哥哥，你好点了吗？你刚刚说什么来着……

say:3:1460462003:1.text: Right... our little brother, Jarel! He's disappeared!
say:3:1460462003:1.source_cn: 我刚刚……对，我弟弟！我弟弟雅尔泽不见了！

choice_prompt:4:1460462003.text: Right... our little brother, Jarel! He's disappeared!
choice_prompt:4:1460462003.source_cn: 我刚刚……对，我弟弟！我弟弟雅尔泽不见了！

say:5:1460462004:2.text: Sorry, I got worked up again. I always get like this when something happens.
say:5:1460462004:2.source_cn: 呼……抱歉，我又激动了，我老是这样，一遇到事就容易着急上火。

say:6:1460462005:1.text: It's Jarel—he's the youngest of us three. Me, Bona, and him. He's a shy little boy, nothing like us.
say:6:1460462005:1.source_cn: 是我和珀娜的小弟弟，雅尔泽，他和我们俩不一样，是个胆小...

say:7:1460462007:1.text: He's terrified of anything even close to danger. Whenever we'd talk about the surface, he'd cover his ears and hide in the closet.
say:7:1460462007:1.source_cn: 他从一开始就很讨厌什么地面上的传说，光是听我们的冒险故...

say:8:1460462008:1.text: Later he just started locking himself in his room.
say:8:1460462008:1.source_cn: 以前都会藏在柜子里，后面就干脆在房间里锁上门不出声。

say:9:1460462009:1.text: Today, Bona and I got caught up planning another adventure. Probably got too loud. When I went to check on him, he was gone.
say:9:1460462009:1.source_cn: 今天我和珀娜约好了出去冒险，大概讨论得太激烈了，我出门...

choice_prompt:10:1460462009.text: Today, Bona and I got caught up planning another adventure. Probably got too loud. When I went to check on him, he was gone.
choice_prompt:10:1460462009.source_cn: 今天我和珀娜约好了出去冒险，大概讨论得太激烈了，我出门的时候发现，雅尔泽不见了！

say:11:1460462010:1.text: Nope. I checked every cabinet, every drawer. Searched the whole room. No sign of him!
say:11:1460462010:1.source_cn: 不在，我每个柜子都找了 ，房间里外也找了，他不见了！

say:12:1460462012:1.text: And Jarel's scared of the outside world. He wouldn't just wander off...
say:12:1460462012:1.source_cn: 雅尔泽他很怕外面，我没法想象他到底逃跑到哪去了……

say:14:1460462013:1.text: So that's why you didn't come adventuring with us today...
say:14:1460462013:1.source_cn: 怪不得今天冒险你都没来陪我们！原来是因为这个……

say:15:1460462014:1.text: It wasn't just that. The more I searched, the more helpless I felt.
say:15:1460462014:1.source_cn: 不止是因为这个，我找不到雅尔泽，着急得不得了。

say:16:1460462015:1.text: And then this weird idea popped into my head: If I were one of those heroes from the legends, maybe I'd be able to find him and fix everything.
say:16:1460462015:1.source_cn: 不知道怎么回事，突然觉得，如果我是传说中的英雄，是不是...

say:17:1460462016:1.text: And then... well, you saw what happened after that...
say:17:1460462016:1.source_cn: 然后就……变成前头那个样子了……

say:19:1460462017:1.text: Meanwhile your sister almost got eaten by a monster while playing with other kids!
say:19:1460462017:1.source_cn: 你妹妹自己跟那帮孩子在外头玩，也差点遭遇危险！

say:20:1460462018:1.text: But... I get it. Being a big brother's tough. And maybe you were not exactly at your best either...
say:20:1460462018:1.source_cn: 算了，当哥哥的也不容易，更何况你可能得病了……

choice_prompt:21:1460462018.text: But... I get it. Being a big brother's tough. And maybe you were not exactly at your best either...
choice_prompt:21:1460462018.source_cn: 算了，当哥哥的也不容易，更何况你可能得病了……

say:22:1460462019:1.text: Good idea. You two stay here. We'll go look for your little brother. Got it?
say:22:1460462019:1.source_cn: 嗯，你们兄妹俩乖乖在这里等着，我和这位魔法师帮你们去把...

say:24:1460462020:1.text: Got it! I'll keep an eye on Bona. Please, bring him back safe!
say:24:1460462020:1.source_cn: 明白，我会好好照顾珀娜，雅尔泽就拜托你们了！

say:26:1460462011:1.text: I turned the whole place upside down. He's not anywhere!
say:26:1460462011:1.source_cn: 是的，我家里每个角落都翻遍了，根本不见他的人影！

say:27:1460462006:2.text: Yeah, Jarel—the youngest of us three. Unlike me and Bona, he's shy and gets scared easily.
say:27:1460462006:2.source_cn: 是的，我和珀娜的小弟弟，雅尔泽，他胆子非常小，和我们俩...
